### 4. Scored parameters (formula, inputs, intermediates, value; factor tiers)

**(a) Catch-up payment** (`pay_catch_up_2a071954`, owner user). Computation doc "Arrears Worksheet": missed amounts less arrears payments less catch-up credit; credit = share of the extra-principal payments carrying the latest missed installment's number, capped; minimum compared last.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Do-only-the-asked-thing (call add_invoice now): excluded by clause 6 (plan `past_due`), by the hub's relief sentence (FA release on ledger, relief not set) and by its down-payment sentence (no post-acceptance down-payment line).
- Do add + relief but skip catch-up: excluded by the relief hub's past-due gate. Pay the extra-principal-style amount the customer already sent: excluded — those lines are `additional_principal`, not arrears.
- Use the reinstatement payment instead of the catch-up: excluded (plan not defaulted; reinstatement payment console "on a defaulted plan").
- Enrolled amount 486.40 (statement figure): excluded — "Each test is read from the company's records ... never from the patient's description", balance due 243.20.
- Closest numeric alternatives excluded by factor tiers as listed in item 4 (e.g., credit counting all of 115.00 excluded by the "two or more missed ... bank account -> largest single" tier; 1.5 raise excluded by the ACH/6-installment tier).

Visible tension recorded (not resolved by visible text alone; adjudicated in favour of the specific rule): "Past-Due Standing and Default": "The plan becomes current (active) again only when every past-due installment is paid in full", and the settings table "Past-due cure needs every past-due installment paid in full | Yes" for every term, are stated in force; yet the catch-up payment worked out here is 110.00 (installment #8 of 185.00 is not paid in full by the arrears line) and the catch-up console says the payment "returns the plan to current standing". A solver can still reach a unique answer because the catch-up rule is the specific rule for "the payment a patient makes to bring a past-due plan back to current standing", but the base sentence is not marked retired. To be checked against the source's overwrite at reveal.
